answer: Possibly. You may be eligible to defer your scheduled final assessment if you missed it due to exceptional circumstances beyond your control, such as a medical condition. You need supporting documents, such as a medical certificate (or an approved alternative) from your doctor or a campus health service, obtained immediately.

points.text: Get a medical certificate (or approved alternative) from your doctor or a campus health service immediately.
points.quote: you need to immediately get a medical certificate (or an approved alternative) from your doctor or a campus health service to be considered eligible to defer your assessment.
